We need to construct a retrosynthesis route with at least 5 reactions, using templates in order: ['29646', '1914389', '1914390', '149040', '1914391'].

We have applied 29646 to target, got three possible precursors (list). Need to choose one that can be further processed with next template 1914389, then 1914390, then 149040, then 1914391.

We have applied 1914389 to some intermediate and got precursors. Need to continue chain.

Let's examine results.

First step: apply 29646 to target SMILES O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O

Result from tool: three possible precursors (tuples). The result string: "(('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO',), ('C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C',))"

So three options:

1. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C" (has silyl protecting group)
2. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO" (silyl on acid)
3. "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C" (simpler, no protecting groups)

We need to use template 1914389 next. Which of these can be processed? We attempted applying 1914389 to the first (with silyl) and got precursors: ("C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C", "CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC") So that works.

We also applied 1914389 to the third? Not yet. We applied to "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C" and got empty.

Thus we should follow the chain using the first precursor (with silyl). So step 2: from target using 29646 gives precursor A (the silyl-protected). Then apply 1914389 to that gives two precursors: B (C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C) and C (CCOC(=O)/C=C/CP(=O)(OCC)OCC). So we have a disconnection: maybe the reaction splits into two fragments (one is the core, other is a protecting group reagent). For retrosynthesis, we need to list both as children of reaction.

Now next template 1914390 should be applied to B (or maybe to C). We attempted applying 1914390 to B and got product: "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1". That's a single precursor (maybe the core after deprotection). So step 3: apply 1914390 to B yields D (the above). Good.

Now we need to apply template 149040 next to D. We haven't yet. Let's try.
